description: FastAPI is a Python framework for web APIs. Type hints help it check inputs and describe routes. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.
versionNote: Examples use FastAPI with Pydantic 2 and Python 3.10 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Supply a query default with FastAPI
Point to another URL with FastAPI
learningObjectives: Limit an input range with FastAPI
